title: experiment-canvas-and-statistical-sentinels-for-model-version-tests
creator: Ravi Patel
description:
Problem: Teams need a single, low-friction surface to run model-version experiments (canaries, A/B, shadow) with deterministic exposure controls and automated statistical checks that reduce manual monitoring and human error. Current experiments are ad-hoc, vary by service, and lack standardized auto-rollback criteria.

Goal: Ship an Experiment Canvas in the Console + API that lets product/ML/infra teams: (1) define experiment variants and traffic policies, (2) attach metric sets and statistical sentinels, (3) schedule exposure windows and cohorts, (4) optionally mirror shadow traffic with privacy masks, and (5) configure auto-rollback with hysteresis to avoid flapping. The canvas should emit clear audit logs and integrate with Optimize recommendations.

Scope: MVP covers A/B and canary experiments with: exposure curves (percent over time), cohort targeting, sequential/batch statistical checks (frequentist and Bayesian), safety windows (quota caps), shadow mirroring for offline evaluation, and an auto-rollback policy engine supporting threshold, trend, and Bayesian posterior triggers. Integrations: Console experiment UI, Redwood API, rollout telemetry stream, and alerts into PagerDuty/Slack.

Out of scope for MVP: fully managed multi-metric causality analysis, automated counterfactual replay across all downstream services, and complex cohort stratification beyond basic attributes (region, customer_tier).
acceptance_criteria: Console: Users can create an experiment with two or more model variants, configure exposure schedule (start, end, target percentages), and target cohorts (region, customer_tier)
API: Experiments can be created/updated via Redwood API with identical semantics to the Console and return experiment_id and immutable audit record links

Statistical engine: System runs preconfigured checks every evaluation interval and publishes results: (a) frequentist sequential test (alpha-adjusted), (b) Bayesian risk estimate (posterior probability that variant < baseline by delta), and (c) uplift with 95% CI

Auto-rollback: Customers can configure rollback policies using logical predicates (e.g., p_value < 0.01 AND relative_latency_increase > 15% OR bayes_prob(regression) > 0.95) and an experiment with a failing predicate triggers a controlled rollback and audit event

Shadowing: Console allows enabling request mirroring to a variant with configurable sampling and PII masking; mirrored responses are logged to the experiment bucket without impacting production latency
Safety quotas: Experiment-level daily request caps and customer-level exposure caps are enforced and visible in the Console; exceeding caps pauses exposure and notifies owners
Telemetry: Per-variant time-series metrics (latency P50/P95, error rate, key application metrics) are available in Experiment dashboard and link to cost/usage breakdowns
Observability: Experiment emits structured events for start/stop/exposure-change/rollback and integrates with existing tracing and alerting pipelines
Docs & quickstart: A short Console walkthrough and API reference exist with an example canary that rolls 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 24 hours
tasks: Draft Experiment Canvas wireframes and UX flows with solutions engineering
Define experiment API contract and payloads with Engineering (variants, traffic_schedule, metrics, rollback_policy)
Implement statistical sentinels: sequential frequentist, Bayesian posterior monitor, and uplift + CI computation
Expose safety quotas in control plane and enforce in request router
Add shadowing pipeline: mirroring path, PII masking, and storage to experiment bucket
Build Console experiment creation/editor and experiment dashboard views
Hook experiment lifecycle events into telemetry & alerts (PagerDuty/Slack) and add audit trail
Run internal dogfood: 3 experiments across Search, Summarization, and Re-ranking teams
Draft runbook for operators: how to interpret sentinels and manual rollback steps
implementation_notes:
Statistical details: support both group-sequential alpha spending (Pocock/O'Brien-Fleming options) and continuous Bayesian monitoring. Default thresholds: frequentist alpha=0.01 for safety-critical metrics, bayes_prob>0.95 for automated rollback. Provide sane defaults but expose full predicate language in API.

Rollback hysteresis: require rollback predicate to be true for two consecutive evaluation windows or for X aggregated traffic units to avoid noisy flips.

Shadowing privacy: default PII maskers applied to mirrored payloads; customers can opt-out per-variant. Ensure mirrored path never touches production response path to avoid latency regression.

Telemetry payloads should include variant_id, experiment_id, sample_weight, cohort_tags, and metric_key so downstream analytics can join events reliably.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives triggering rollbacks due to noisy signals. Mitigation: hysteresis + multiple sentinel agreement + require minimum traffic threshold before automatic rollback
Risk: Shadowed mirrored requests leaking PII. Mitigation: default PII masking, consent flags, preserve S3 bucket ACLs and encryption, and security review
Risk: Complexity of predicate language leading to misconfig. Mitigation: provide templates and a simulator in the Console to run predicates against historical trace data
Risk: Performance overhead from per-request tagging. Mitigation: only attach lightweight experiment metadata and do heavy aggregation offline
notes: Related: ties into Optimize recommendations for suggested exposure curves and quantization suggestions for cheaper variants
Eng alignment: coordinate with ENG serving runtime team for rollout hooks and ENG infra for quota enforcement
Legal/Privacy: notify compliance for shadowing policy and storage retention settings
